cases: TC-1 · REQ-1, AC-1 lead-time demand is average daily sales times lead time in days · average daily sales 50, lead time 6 days, stock on hand 360 → lead-time demand 300 (50*6, not 50+6=56), safety stock 60, reorder point 360, recommends a reorder

TC-2 · REQ-2 safety stock is 20 percent of lead-time demand, not of daily sales · average daily sales 25, lead time 8 days, stock on hand 240 → lead-time demand 200 (25*8), safety stock 40 (0.2*200, not 0.2*25=5), reorder point 240 (not 205), recommends a reorder

TC-3 · REQ-3 reorder point is lead-time demand plus safety stock, equal to 1.2 times lead-time demand · average daily sales 80, lead time 5 days, stock on hand 480 → lead-time demand 400 (80*5), safety stock 80, reorder point 480 (400+80, not 400, not 400+20=420, not 400+16=416), recommends a reorder

TC-4 · REQ-4, AC-2 recommend a reorder when stock on hand is exactly at the reorder point · average daily sales 50, lead time 6 days, stock on hand 360 → reorder point 360, recommends a reorder (360 is at 360; a strict less-than check would not)

TC-5 · REQ-4, AC-3 do not recommend a reorder when stock on hand is one above the reorder point · average daily sales 50, lead time 6 days, stock on hand 361 → reorder point 360, does not recommend a reorder (361 is above 360)
TC-6 · REQ-4 edge, stock one below the reorder point · average daily sales 50, lead time 6 days, stock on hand 359 → reorder point 360, recommends a reorder (359 is below 360)

TC-7 · REQ-4 stock above lead-time demand but still at or below the reorder point · average daily sales 50, lead time 6 days, stock on hand 301 → lead-time demand 300, reorder point 360, recommends a reorder (301<=360; comparing only to lead-time demand would not)

TC-8 · REQ-1, REQ-4 same rule on other quantities, stock exactly at that reorder point · average daily sales 10, lead time 10 days, stock on hand 120 → lead-time demand 100 (10*10), safety stock 20, reorder point 120 (not the example 360), recommends a reorder

TC-9 · REQ-4 other quantities, stock one above that reorder point · average daily sales 10, lead time 10 days, stock on hand 121 → lead-time demand 100, safety stock 20, reorder point 120, does not recommend a reorder

TC-10 · REQ-4 other quantities, stock one below that reorder point · average daily sales 10, lead time 10 days, stock on hand 119 → lead-time demand 100, safety stock 20, reorder point 120, recommends a reorder

TC-11 · REQ-4 other quantities, stock between lead-time demand and reorder point · average daily sales 10, lead time 10 days, stock on hand 101 → lead-time demand 100, reorder point 120, recommends a reorder (101<=120; 101 is not at or below 100)

TC-12 · REQ-1 lead time of 1 day · average daily sales 40, lead time 1 day, stock on hand 48 → lead-time demand 40 (40*1), safety stock 8 (0.2*40), reorder point 48 (40+8, not 41*1.2=49.2), recommends a reorder

TC-13 · REQ-1 average daily sales of 1 · average daily sales 1, lead time 5 days, stock on hand 6 → lead-time demand 5 (1*5, not 1+5=6), safety stock 1 (0.2*5), reorder point 6 (5+1), recommends a reorder
